faq.q: What is the origin of Emin?
faq.a: Emin is associated with Arabic. Emin is Arabic أَمِين (Amīn), meaning 'trustworthy, faithful'.
Yes — the underlying form أَمِين is Arabic.
Emin can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Emin should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Amīn is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Emin mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Emin is rendered امین and carries the sense امین، امانت دار.

faq.q: What does Emin mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Emin is rendered امین and carries the sense امین، امین.

faq.q: What are the variants of Emin?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Emin, emin. Script forms are أَمِين, امين, امین, अमीन.

faq.q: Is Emin a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
